results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/before"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.withBeforeActions(
        AfterAction.afterAction()
                .withHttpRequestTemplate(
                        template(HttpTemplate.TemplateType.VELOCITY)
                                .withTemplate("{ \"method\": \"PUT\", \"path\": \"/hook/before/$!request.headers['orderid'][0]\", \"headers\": [ { \"name\": \"Host\", \"values\": [ \"localhost:<port>\" ] }, { \"name\": \"X-Order\", \"values\": [ \"$!request.headers['orderid'][0]\" ] } ] }")
                )
                .withFailurePolicy(org.mockserver.model.FailurePolicy.FAIL_FAST)
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("triggered")
);

results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/mustache"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.withAfterActions(
        AfterAction.afterAction()
                .withHttpRequestTemplate(
                        template(HttpTemplate.TemplateType.MUSTACHE)
                                .withTemplate("{ \"method\": \"POST\", \"path\": \"/hook/mustache/{{ request.headers.orderid.0 }}\", \"headers\": [ { \"name\": \"Host\", \"values\": [ \"localhost:<port>\" ] }, { \"name\": \"X-Order\", \"values\": [ \"{{ request.headers.orderid.0 }}\" ] } ], \"body\": \"received {{ request.method }} {{ request.path }} with {{ request.body }}\" }")
                )
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("triggered")
);
